skills.name: ppt-animation

skills.whenToUse: 用户要做 PPT 风格演示、翻页演示、幻灯片、slides、科普演示动画、录屏课件时使用

skills.name: flowchart
skills.description: 生成教育/科普类流程图、概念图、原理演示的动画 HTML 页面。用 CSS/SVG 绘制节点和连线，支持流动箭头、逐步出现、hover 高亮等动画效果，暗色科技风。内置 RNN/LSTM/GRU/MLP/Word2Vec/GPU 等 AI 模型可视化模板，适合技术讲解、视频科普、PPT 配图场景。
skills.whenToUse: 用户要流程图、概念图、原理演示、示意图、神经网络/AI 模型可视化动画时使用

skills.name: network-protocol-viz

skills.whenToUse: 用户要网络协议可视化、协议演示、TCP/HTTP/HTTPS/以太帧/IPv4/路由/DHCP 动画时使用

skills.name: dynamic-archify
skills.description: Create professional architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as standalone animated HTML files with SVG graphics, flowing animation effects, a built-in dark/light theme toggle, and one-click export to PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/GIF/WebM. Accepts plain-language descriptions or pasted Mermaid code and lays the diagram out from scratch.
skills.whenToUse: 用户要系统架构图、基础设施图、云架构、网络拓扑、技术工作流、审批流、CI/CD 流程、API 调用时序、数据管道、状态机、或 Mermaid 图美化/导出时使用

skills.name: scholar-notes
